information: #![Bandera ESP](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0E5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c7812c9b5d2929fb4ed7644517bf4f9800a3d1e4/esp.png) **Español** Si eres socio de la **Asociación Española de Speedcubing (AES)** a día 19 de octubre de 2025 y participas en la competición se te reembolsarán 2.5€ de la cuota de registro al finalizar ésta. Puedes hacerte socio de la AES pinchando [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). El Corazón de la Axarquía II 2025 se celebra en honor a Owen Pérez, un joven cubero que tristemente falleció de forma repentina en 2024. Owen compitió en el UMA Open 2023 y en el Écija Open 2024. Además de ser un talentoso cubero, era un chico inteligente, creativo y divertido, y se le echa mucho de menos. --- #![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png) **English** If you are **Spanish Speedcubing Association (AES)** member on October 19, 2025 and you participate in the competition, you will be reimbursed €2.5 of the registration fee at the end of the competition. You can join AES by clicking [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). El Corazón de la Axarquía II 2025 is being held in honour of Owen Pérez, a young cuber who sadly suddenly passed away in 2024. Owen competed in the UMA Open 2023 and the Ecija Open 2024. As well as being a talented cuber, he was a smart, creative and fun boy, and he is greatly missed.
